texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER HARVESTING - Buguey: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Reproductive. Recommended action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Buguey: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER HARVESTING - Dupax del Norte: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Maturing. Recommended action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer harvesting in Dupax del Norte. Recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER HARVESTING - Dupax del Norte
Operation: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field
Why defer: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Maturing.
LGU/MAO action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Dupax del Norte: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.
Apply split fertilizer doses when field conditions improve.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Dupax del Norte: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.

texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Dupax del Norte
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.

🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Dupax del Norte:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Corn season 2 - Maturing. Recommended action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer harvesting in Villaverde. Recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER HARVESTING - Villaverde
Operation: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field
Why defer: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Corn season 2 - Maturing.
LGU/MAO action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Harvesting - Villaverde: Please defer manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field for now. Reason: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment. Current crop calendar basis: Corn season 2 - Maturing. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Villaverde: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Corn season 2 - Maturing. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
